_about: The review of every law of the Core against the four axioms of the Omega42 Existential Framework (Core L-534; Companion Part 146; after APE-320 to APE-323). A law is KEPT when it is consistent with the axioms as it stands, AMENDED where a sentence aligns it, ADDED where the framework needed a law; none is retired. python3 tools/oef.py --laws reads every law from the Core and checks each amendment in its text, in CI.
